cases.description: When the versionFlag argument is null the method should return null.
VersionFlag V202012 should map to a new Version202012 object.
VersionFlag V201909 should map to a new Version201909 object.
VersionFlag V7 should map to a new Version7 object.
VersionFlag V6 should map to a new Version6 object.
VersionFlag V4 should map to a new Version4 object.
Any VersionFlag value that is not explicitly handled should cause an IllegalArgumentException.

cases.expected: new instance each call (different object references)
cases.description: Calling checkVersion twice with the same supported flag (V4) should return two distinct objects, confirming that the method does not cache instances.
Even though the return type is JsonSchemaVersion, verify at runtime that the created object indeed implements this interface for a supported flag (V7).
Validate that the IllegalArgumentException thrown for an unsupported enum constant contains the exact expected message (no extra whitespace).

cases.expected: instance of com.networknt.schema.Version202012 and not null
cases.description: Confirm that a supported flag (V202012) returns a non‑null object of the correct concrete class.

cases.expected: instance of com.networknt.schema.Version6 and not null
cases.description: Confirm that a supported flag (V6) returns a non‑null object of the correct concrete class.
